context: A source audit found that exact U.S. equity index percentage changes in the prior Binance/XRP snapshot were attributed to a Reuters source that only described broad risk-off context.
decision: A numerical observation must cite the source that contains the exact numerical value, not merely a related source describing the same broad event.
Preserve the original snapshot and append a corrected immutable copy with the Guardian source for the exact Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow changes.
Keep the macro observation out of the predictive feature store; a daily index move does not identify the causal effect of the Binance incident on XRP.
invariants: No historical snapshot or source record is overwritten.
No market feature is admitted from this correction.
No main-branch modification, merge, force-push or workflow dispatch.
